summary: IW Technologies (weareiw.com) describes itself as a family-owned, operator-run POS hardware and IT lifecycle services provider with nearly 50 years of experience, serving multi-site Retail, Grocery, QSR, Hospitality, Convenience, and Distribution brands. (Scope note: Entity identification risk: 'IW' as a bare slug is ambiguous; this finding assumes IW Technologies is the intended company based on category fit (POS hardware) and should be confirmed against the source system that generated the slug.)

IW Technologies operates a 240,000 sq ft warehouse/distribution facility at 2790 Pinnacle Drive, Elgin, IL, stocking new and refurbished POS hardware (printers, scanners, terminals) for nationwide rollouts.

IW Technologies advertises 'Rapid-Scale Deployments in Under 8 Weeks' and states it supported 50+ checkout lanes/locations across North America in 2024, combining hardware sourcing, field deployment, break/fix, and secure IT-asset disposition under one team. (Scope note: Self-reported deployment metric; no independent case study or customer name backs the 2024 figure.)
